hypotheses.justification: Keep hX and split on the sign of XR. For XR > 0, use the existing proof. For XR < 0, the definitions and Real.log_neg_eq_log show that heatE, U, and OutgoingDilation.E are unchanged when XR is replaced by -XR; apply heatE_times_U at -XR. Meanwhile patchRadius F XR < 0, so X / patchRadius F XR < 0 and correction_zero_outside makes patchIncrement zero, since compensationPatch.left = 1. For XR = 0, both radii are zero: division by zero and Real.log_zero make the switch zero by OutgoingSchedule.sigma_zero, and correction_zero_outside makes the correction at zero vanish. Thus E equals OutgoingDilation.E in this case.

Keep hXR. The proof of patchIncrement * U = 0 already works for every X, since correction_times_U_zero has no positivity assumption on X. Extend the heatE step as follows. At X = 0, Real.log_zero and OutgoingSchedule.sigma_zero make the switch zero, so heatE equals OutgoingDilation.E. For X < 0, put Y = -X > 0. By the definitions and Real.log_neg_eq_log, U at X equals U at Y, and the heat switch at X equals that at Y. If Y ≤ switchRadius F XR, HeatTailEdit.switch_zero makes heatE unchanged at X. Otherwise U_after_switch makes U at Y, hence at X, zero. The original argument handles X > 0.
